homepage_policy: One adaptive life journey: identity -> seven source-linked life chapters -> NOW -> live public signals -> contextual AI. Chronology remains authoritative and journey progress is stored locally in the visitor browser only.
resilience_policy: The homepage reads /api/social-feed first for connected social content; source-linked archive material remains a clearly labeled fallback and live-feed failure must not erase known content.
telegram_policy: Telegram Inbox is pending-review-only and disabled unless webhook secret and allowed-chat configuration are present. No webhook intake auto-publishes.
evidence_policy: VERIFIED / SELF-REPORTED / INFERRED / UNKNOWN remain distinct; aggregate reach, impressions and impact are not claimed as verified without source evidence.
corpus_policy: MASTER CANON remains narrative authority; MASTER EVIDENCE LEDGER remains catalog/evidence authority; AppDeploy is the validated public projection.
visual_policy: Editorial cinematic presentation with real/source media first, one dominant visual per life chapter, related media secondary, no collage-first layout and source actions retained.
responsive_policy: Mobile-first journey UI preserves hero legibility, a swipeable chapter rail, >=42px primary controls, source actions and no page-level horizontal overflow.
